column1: # How apps/web/gods-eye-view differs from upstream bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view.
# This copy is upstream at the base commit below, plus the license header
# //tools/license:add gives each file, plus exactly the changes listed here,
# proves it; `sync` moves the base and rewrites the line itself. Paths are
# relative to apps/web/gods-eye-view; a path ending in / covers a directory of
# files upstream does not have. See upstream/README.md.
# change: added (only here), modified (both, but different), deleted (only upstream)

column3: tree
why
Build context for the monorepo's Dockerfile.
Bazel targets. Named BUILD.bazel because a file named BUILD collides with upstream's build/ directory on case-insensitive file systems.
The production image, published to GHCR and deployed by gitops/argocd.
Monorepo code ownership.

The production server the image runs. Upstream serves its /api routes from its Vite dev server; this serves dist/ and mounts upstream's own provider plugins through their configurePreviewServer hooks, as `vite preview` does, so upstream's routes reach production with each sync.
Bazel entry point for upstream's test runner: puts a real node ahead of the rules_js shim, which upstream's spawned scripts cannot use.
:cesium_assets_test, which checks the bundle carries Cesium's static assets.
Pins HOME_VIEW, the landing view src/camera.js adds.
The monorepo's end-to-end suite against the production server.

:server_test, which boots server.mjs from the Dockerfile's runtime layout and checks it serves every route upstream mounts for `vite preview`, none of the dev-only ones, and the same-site gate on the paid ones.

The CelesTrak mirror: the script .github/workflows/gods-eye-view-tle-mirror.yaml runs every 6 hours from GitHub's runners, because connections from the homelab to celestrak.org time out, and its test, which holds its groups to the client's.
This tracking: the tool, its tests, this list and the sync brief.
The monorepo is one pnpm workspace; pnpm-lock.yaml at the repository root is the lockfile.
Upstream's CI, which never runs here; Dependabot bumps its action pins with the rest of the repository's.

Dependencies at the monorepo's one version (cesium, sharp); @cesium/engine declared, which upstream's tests import and npm hoists but pnpm does not; ws a runtime dependency, since upstream's AIS provider requires it at run time and the image installs dependencies only; `start` runs server.mjs.
Tries a mirror of CelesTrak's groups first when CELESTRAK_TLE_MIRROR_URL is set, then CelesTrak: production cannot reach celestrak.org (see tle-mirror/).
Lands on HOME_VIEW (Irvine, CA) instead of Austin, TX.
Follows flyToAustin's rename to flyToHome.
HOME_VIEW, one constant for the landing view, and flyToHome in place of flyToAustin.
git grep exits 128 in the Bazel sandbox, which has no .git, as well as 1 for no match.
The stalled request holds a timer, so node does not exit before the abort under Bazel, and an already-aborted signal rejects at once.
The stalled lookups hold a timer, so node does not exit before the abort under Bazel, and an already-aborted signal rejects at once.
Replaces vite-plugin-cesium's asset copy with a dereferencing one, because the rules_js fs patches reject its walk over pnpm's symlinks and the bundle shipped without dist/cesium.
